policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 16 Mar close (1x4 3.85, 3x6 3.97, 6x9 4.11, 9x12 4.24 vs WIBOR 3M 3.82) price roughly 40bp of NBP hikes within 12 months. The MPC cut by 25bp to 3.75% on 4 Mar (a 'hawkish cut', ING); the projection excludes the war. Glapiński (5 Mar): if things calm within about two months, one more cut is back on the table; no forward guidance. Kotecki (11-12 Mar): the March cut was probably the last this year; Janczyk: wait-and-see for months. Core CPI fell to 2.5% in February (16 Mar).
policy.risk_text: The market prices NBP hikes while MPC members lean to holding: if oil and inflation expectations keep rising the front end has further to go; the fuel shield and a ceasefire are the relief valves. Long end: global term premia (Bund >3%) and the fiscal cost of the shield.

cpi.m: Feb (GUS, 13 Mar; COICOP 2018, new weights); core 2.5%

macro.projection_text: NBP March projection (4 Mar; data to 19 Feb, war excluded): CPI 50% bands 1.6-2.9% (2026), 1.1-3.7% (2027); central path 2.3% / 2.4% / 2.3% (2026-28), GDP 3.9% in 2026 (Inflation Report, 6 Mar).
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit ~7.0% of GDP (MoF figures in Fitch: 7.0% / 6.5% / 6.2% for 2025-27, debt ~70% of GDP by 2027); 2026 deficit cap PLN 271.7bn; the President vetoed the SAFE law (12 Mar); the cabinet plans to take the SAFE loan via BGK for the Armed Forces Support Fund (13 Mar); budget deficit after February PLN 48.5bn (17.8% of the limit).
macro.fiscal_risk_text: 2026 needs ~38% (25 Feb) financed; MoF cancelled the 11 Mar switch; turned the 18 Mar sale into a switch; budget accounts ~PLN 171.6bn at end-February. Moody's reviews Poland on 20 Mar (A2, negative).
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP cut to 3.75% on 4 Mar after holding at 4.00% in January and February; February CPI 2.1% y/y on new weights; 2025 GDP 3.6%, Q4 4.0%. Ratings: Fitch A- negative (affirmed 27 Feb), Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable. 16 Mar: MoF turned the 18 Mar sale into a switch auction; core CPI fell to 2.5% in February (first at or below target since 2019); January current account +EUR 1.15bn (-0.3bn expected); the budget deficit after February was PLN 48.5bn. Abroad: Brent ~$100-105; allies declined to join Hormuz operations; Trump demanded an emergency Fed cut.

calendar.plan_text: MoF March plan (27 Feb): sale auctions on 18 and 25 Mar (PLN 7-13bn each; OK0128, NZ0331, PS0731 (new 5Y fixed), DS1035, NZ0936 (new 10Y POLSTR floater)) and a switch on 11 Mar buying back OK0426, DS0726, PS1026, WZ1126 and OK0127; no T-bills; WZ sales ended in February. February sales were ~PLN 41bn; ~38% of 2026 needs financed. 9 Mar: MoF cancelled the 11 Mar switch because of market volatility. BGK cancelled its 12 Mar FPC auction (11 Mar). Domański (13 Mar): supply will be adjusted to market conditions. 16 Mar: the 18 Mar sale becomes a switch auction.
calendar.timing_text: The Aug 2025-Feb 2026 pattern (auction-day close the cheapest point of the week) comes from a rally regime; in March's sell-off MoF is cutting supply (switch instead of sale, a smaller 25 Mar offer), so remaining dates (18 and 25 Mar) are less of a supply event. Next MPC 8-9 Apr: a hold is expected while the market prices hikes.

facts.core_text: Regime: war shock - oil and global yields up, PLN weaker; the NBP cut to 3.75% and turned wait-and-see while FRAs price roughly 40bp of NBP hikes; the ECB is priced for hikes, the Fed is on hold, the BoE has turned hawkish, the CNB and MNB are on hold. (Erste's CDS/spread table for 16 Mar looked stale or inconsistent, so it is not quoted.) Brent ~$100-105 (16 Mar).

quasi_takeaways: FPC fixed lines trade ~{lo}-{hi}bp over the POLGB curve (average {avg}bp); widest ASW {widest} at {widest_asw}bp. Same State Treasury guarantee as POLGBs.
Best pickup: {best} ({best_sp}bp vs POLGB). For buy-and-hold books the guarantee makes the pickup attractive; liquidity is the cost (Pekao became BGK market maker on 13 Nov 2025).
Supply: BGK cancelled the 12 Mar FPC auction and says ~60% of its 2026 FPC financing is already raised (11 Mar).
Use auctions, not Catalyst: trades are small retail lots and some lines go weeks without a print.
